scope: Greater Tokyo / Kanto rail display colors for michi_app

important: Do not match operator or network alone.
Do not use substring/fuzzy matching for ambiguous names such as 新宿線.
Prefer a unique exact alias match; otherwise use fallbackColor and report the unmatched identity.

notes: OSM-style aliases are based on the naming forms documented by the OpenStreetMap Wiki Japan Railways table and common operator-prefixed variants expected in OSM route relations.

Japanese Wikipedia is used for the recognized line-color identity/color-name context. Exact hex values are practical display values cross-referenced against Greater-Tokyo palette data and, for selected lines, structured color data.
This file is intentionally a display-style lookup, not an authoritative infrastructure classification.
